verdict.rationale: GitLab documents AI false-positive detection that runs automatically after each security scan and gives confidence scores with explanations for each assessment. That covers flagging likely false positives and explaining the assessment, but it requires the Ultimate tier plus a GitLab Duo add-on. The evidence does not show AI deduplication of findings or general AI explanation of vulnerabilities. Missing for 10: AI-driven deduplication of findings, AI explanation of findings beyond false-positive assessments, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI to triage findings — explaining them, deduplicating, and flagging likely false positives

citations.quote: false positive detection runs automatically after each security scan and provides confidence scores with explanations for each assessment
